rationale: This role owns the complete product solution strategy for Epson's Professional Imaging division. Given that Epson's value proposition centers on enabling durable outdoor graphics but they don't control the protective film layer, this leader would care deeply about completing their solution stack. Tedlar partnership would address critical gaps: (1) COMPETITIVE DIFFERENTIATION - being able to offer validated 'print + protect' solutions with 20+ year durability claims versus HP/Canon/Mimaki competitors who also lack integrated protection solutions; (2) CUSTOMER SUCCESS METRICS - their print service provider customers face warranty claims and callbacks when graphics fail prematurely, which reflects poorly on Epson equipment performance and drives churn; (3) SOLUTION COMPLETENESS - currently customers must navigate fragmented overlaminate options themselves, creating friction in the sales cycle that a recommended Tedlar partnership would eliminate; (4) CREDIBILITY FOR OUTDOOR CLAIMS - Epson heavily markets 'weather-resistant' and 'outdoor durability' but actual longevity depends on overlaminates they don't control—Tedlar's 60+ year proven performance provides third-party validation of their outdoor messaging. This role controls product positioning, go-to-market strategy, and ecosystem partnerships, making them the primary decision-maker for strategic co-marketing relationships. They own P&L impact from customer retention and competitive win rates that Tedlar partnership would directly improve.

Epson operates exclusively through an authorized reseller network model, making channel enablement absolutely critical to their business. This role would care about Tedlar partnership because: (1) RESELLER ENABLEMENT - their 100+ authorized resellers need complete workflow solutions to sell effectively; currently resellers must educate themselves on protective films across multiple vendors, creating complexity and support burden that a standardized Tedlar recommendation would eliminate; (2) SALES CYCLE ACCELERATION - resellers report that customers demand complete 'turnkey' solutions; being able to offer Epson printer + Tedlar protection as a validated system reduces sales complexity and shortens close times; (3) REDUCED SUPPORT COSTS - when reseller customers experience premature graphic failures, support calls come back to Epson's channel team even though the issue is overlaminate quality; having a premium recommended solution reduces these support tickets; (4) PREMIUM POSITIONING - Epson positions as high-end equipment manufacturer; their resellers need premium-tier consumables and materials to maintain that positioning and justify price premiums versus competitors; (5) CO-MARKETING LEVERAGE - joint Tedlar partnership provides co-op marketing funds, trade show presence, and educational content that extends Epson's channel marketing budget. This role controls reseller training programs, partner enablement resources, and channel marketing—all mechanisms through which Tedlar could reach Epson's customer base. They are measured on reseller revenue growth, partner satisfaction scores, and channel market share.

This role owns Epson Professional Imaging's market positioning, messaging, and customer education programs—all areas where Tedlar partnership creates immediate value. They would care because: (1) THOUGHT LEADERSHIP AMPLIFICATION - Epson invests heavily in trade show presence (ISA Sign Expo booth #2216, PRINTING United booth #SL8101) and educational sessions; co-exhibiting with Tedlar and offering joint technical workshops positions Epson as solution provider rather than just equipment vendor, strengthening leadership perception; (2) OUTDOOR DURABILITY CLAIMS SUBSTANTIATION - Epson's marketing heavily emphasizes 'weather-resistant,' 'scratch-resistant,' and 'outdoor use' but lacks control over the protective layer that actually determines longevity; partnership with Tedlar (proven 60+ year track record) provides credible third-party validation for these claims and reduces risk of customer disappointment damaging brand reputation; (3) CONTENT MARKETING EXPANSION - Epson runs extensive educational programs (Certified Solution Centers, webinars, demo programs); Tedlar partnership provides case studies, technical guides, and ROI calculators that fill content calendar and demonstrate complete solution expertise; (4) SUSTAINABILITY MESSAGING ALIGNMENT - Epson has committed to carbon neutrality by 2050; Tedlar's extreme longevity (12-20+ year lifespan reducing replacement cycles) and TCO reduction directly support sustainability positioning by minimizing waste; (5) LEAD GENERATION ENHANCEMENT - joint campaigns and gated content around 'complete durable graphics solutions' generate qualified leads for Epson's reseller network. This role controls messaging, trade show strategy, content programs, and co-marketing partnerships, making them the key implementer of any Tedlar collaboration even if Product Management initiates it.
